name: AetherX
slogan: Our Heavy Starship doesn’t pull out. Uranus knows.
motto: Elevating Humanity, One Orbit at a Time.
description: Founded in 2065 by ex-SpaceX renegades, AetherX is the premier megacorp for aggressive deep-space expansion. We deliver conquest. No safe orbits. No gentle landings. Just raw, unrelenting thrust.

achievements.title: Uranus Slingshot
achievements.description: First successful crewed slingshot around Uranus.

achievements.title: Fleet Deployment
achievements.description: Deployment of the Heavy Starship-class fleet.

achievements.title: Titania Outpost
achievements.description: Establishment of New Elysium Outpost on Titania.

achievements.title: Continuous Pounding
achievements.description: Record 47 consecutive days of continuous orbital pounding.

flavorText: The stars are ours for the taking.
Mars is for tourists. Uranus is for us.
